front.title: Witnessed Integrity Attestations for Post-Incident System-State Verification

abstract.t:
This document specifies a Witness Attestation Record (WAR), a signed and hash-linked record created by a witness after it accepts an observation about a subject system. Each record identifies the subject, observation stream, checkpoint, observation time, evidence commitment, witness-local sequence number, and reference to the preceding record. A verifier can validate the record signature, reconstruct the supplied chain, evaluate the applicable policy, and assess freshness against a trusted checkpoint or independently retained chain head.
The component is designed to preserve a verifiable chronology of observations and actions across vulnerability exposure, incident investigation, remediation, and post-remediation verification. It complements evidence-generation and transparency systems. It does not itself establish that a measurement source is truthful, that a host was uncompromised, or that every real-world event was observed.
